description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDao class in PHP, which manages database interactions related to employee skills within the OrangeHRM application. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee skills, as well as managing allowed skills for employees. The class uses Doctrine ORM for database operations and integrates with the project's data transfer objects and entity models.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling EmployeeSkill related database operations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Persists a new or existing EmployeeSkill entity into the database.

methods.name: getEmployeeSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeSkill entity based on employee number and skill ID.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSkills
methods.description: Deletes specified EmployeeSkill records for an employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeSkill
methods.description: Searches for employee skills based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee skills matching search criteria.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkills
methods.description: Retrieves a list of skills not yet assigned to the employee, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of skills not yet assigned to the employee that match the filter.
